text:
ana: Heads up — CI evals started flapping on the new quant model. Batch circuit-breaker (CB) tripped repeatedly, causing retries and metric jitter.

matt: Saw it in staging too. Looks like slow worker + continuous-batching interaction.

sophie: @ana can you paste the CB log + the runner metrics you grabbed?

ana: Paste from runner logs:
```
CB_TRIP shard=shard-12 reason=queue-delay threshold_ms=1200 batches=54 retries=3
worker=worker-7 proc_ms=2300 gc_pause_ms=800
```
Also node cpu spikes -> worker-7 CPU ~85% when this happens.

infra-bot: deploy ci/runner v1.4.3 -> success

kevin: Repro steps I ran: `EVAL_SHARDS=8 make run-eval --mode=stress --seed=42` -> CB flips after ~6m, consistent.

matt: Hypothesis: CB uses a global in-flight count. A single slow worker holding a large batch causes upstream queues to back up, CB sees global backlog and trips. Retries then cause thundering.

sophie: If that's right we should: (1) make CB per-shard or per-worker, (2) add per-shard token-bucket backpressure, (3) surface p95 queue delay in telemetry.

ana: Also CI is marking quality/regression alerts because `mean_latency` jumps. We need to separate infra noise from real model regressions.

kevin: Quick mitigation I tested: reduce `max_batch_size` to 8 and add a 500ms soft timeout on blocking ops. That reduced incidents in my stress run.

matt: Long-term: switch CB policy to percentile-based (use p95 queue delay) and attach CB decisions to shard ids so one flapping worker doesn't trigger global circuit. Also add a CI gate to tag runs with `runner_stability=unstable` so evals from unstable infra don't auto-fail.

sophie: +1. Can you open an RFC and a small PR to scope changes? We should also add a unit test that simulates slow-worker tail latencies.

matt: Will open RFC + PR today. Plan: per-shard CB with a fallback global CB, add `runner.queue.p95` metric, and introduce `eval-runner --stability` flag.

infra-ops: Adding an alert for worker GC spikes and cpu% > 75% sustained. Can add a CPU throttling knob on autoscaler for these test clusters.

ana: I'll attach the failing CI run and extra logs to the RFC. Also adding sample traces for the p95 proposal.

kevin: I'll drop a repro script into `dev/bench/run_stress.sh` and a short README with repro steps.

sophie: Assigning: @matt PR, @kevin repro, @ana CI artifacts, @infra-ops alerts.

matt: ETA for PR: EOD tomorrow, will include tests and telemetry changes. If no improvement, we rollback runner v1.4.3.

ana: ack :thumbsup:

kevin: leaving the stress script in the branch after the PR lands.

sophie: Thanks team. Let's try the mitigation in a small canary cluster first and watch `runner.queue.p95` and `eval.result.stability` before full rollout.
